items.name: RET-001
items.reason: Canonical RET-001 already has a deterministic PREPROD runtime for abandonment risk/recovery planning. External customer dispatch and CRM writes remain disabled, so no duplicate retention engine is created.

items.name: churn / abandonment score
items.reason: Deterministic rules provide a V0 risk score without ML. It is a reusable internal capability, not a live autonomous customer action.

items.name: customer rescue
items.reason: Recovery playbooks can emit communication intent, but customer dispatch remains off until COM-001 physical adapters and permission gates are verified.

items.name: upsell / cross-sell
items.reason: Upsell/cross-sell is a bounded SALE-001 plan generated from retention context; no CRM write, offer dispatch or price mutation is authorized.

items.name: REF-001
items.reason: Canonical REF-001 has a deterministic PREPROD rules runtime for referral timing. No second referral engine or external provider is needed.

items.name: Referral-as-a-Service patterns
items.reason: Pattern source only. The useful referral logic is already represented internally; no external dependency or paid service is justified.

items.name: best referral moment
items.reason: Rules based on satisfaction/outcome select a referral moment and can emit COM-001 intent only; no customer message is dispatched in this scope.

items.name: REP-001
items.reason: Canonical REP-001 has deterministic PREPROD classification/response planning. Public review writes and Google Business writes remain disabled.

items.name: request review
items.reason: Review-request intent exists, but the Google Business/public review adapter is explicitly not live connected. Preserve the plan and audit/wrap the real adapter before any write.

items.name: negative review alert
items.reason: Structured negative-review classification and alert planning are available without storing raw review text or sending an external response.

items.name: low-risk response
items.reason: Low-risk responses can be drafted/planned autonomously, while public posting remains off and high-risk/legal/low-confidence cases stay behind canonical HUMAN_REQUIRED gates.
